description: List every pistol with a cited fit for one optic, each marked direct (with footprint) or adapter (with the plate chain in via). Use it for questions like "what pistols take this red dot". Report the answer exactly as returned: never call an adapter fit a direct fit, and never turn "unknown" into "does not fit". Cite with the returned citation line and link html_url.

optic.description: Optic slug (e.g. "trijicon/rmr-type-2") or name (e.g. "Trijicon RMR Type 2").

name: list_pistols_for_optic
title: List pistols for an optic
